metadata.title: Dow opens lower, putting 3-session win streak in jeopardy, as stock rally pauses ahead of Nvidia earnings - MarketWatch

content.text:
28 min ago
Dow opens lower, putting 3-session win streak in jeopardy, as stock rally pauses ahead of Nvidia earnings
U.S. stocks opened lower on Wednesday as investors digested fresh inflation data and awaited tech bellwether Nvidia's earnings after the bell.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell about 42 points, or 0.1%, to 53,513.
The S&P 500 opened 0.1% lower.
The Nasdaq composite fell 0.2%.
All three major indexes were no more than 3.5% off their recent record highs, with the Dow benefiting from three sessions in a row of gains through Tuesday's close.
